author: The Linux Foundation
description:
Fundamental technologies don’t scale in silos.
As Jim Zemlin, Executive Director of the Linux Foundation, puts it - the development of core, pre-competitive protocols that shape markets require the collaboration of more than one company or developer.

Agentic AI is entering that same moment, and protocols like MCP are what make collaboration possible at scale.

Learn more at https://hubs.la/Q03-pSXn0
title: Protocols shared Infrastructure
